summary: Frontend testing iteration 27: Comprehensive testing of keyboard shortcuts in the Sales page. All 12 keyboard shortcuts tested successfully. The shortcuts work correctly on web platform as expected.

issues: Help button (?) icon is very subtle with grey color (#94a3b8) - consider using a more visible color for better discoverability

critical_code_review_comments: Keyboard shortcuts are well implemented with proper checks for input focus and modal states
The shortcut help modal provides comprehensive documentation of all available shortcuts
Shortcuts correctly require prerequisites (e.g., F1-F4 need lotteries selected)
seed_data_creation: Created test ticket TKT-20260213235543-1019 during Ctrl+Enter shortcut test
context_for_next_testing_agent: All keyboard shortcuts in the Sales page (sales.tsx) are working correctly. The shortcuts are web-only (Platform.OS === 'web') and properly ignore keypresses when user is typing in input fields.

test_1_help_modal_question_mark.description: '?' or 'Shift+/' shortcut opens the keyboard shortcuts help modal 'Atajos de Teclado'

test_3_a_select_all_lotteries.description: 'A' key selects/deselects all open lotteries. Shows '20 lotería(s) seleccionada(s)' badge and 'Deseleccionar' button when all selected

test_4_f1_select_quiniela.description: 'F1' key selects Quiniela play type (requires lotteries selected first). Step 3 shows 'Ingresar Números (Quiniela)'

test_5_f2_select_pale.description: 'F2' key selects Pale play type (requires lotteries selected first)

test_6_r_random_numbers.description: 'R' key generates random numbers based on selected play type (requires lottery and play type selected)

test_7_backspace_delete_number.description: 'Backspace' key removes the last selected number. Step 3 shows 'Ingresa 1 número(s)' after deletion

test_8_enter_add_to_cart.description: 'Enter' key adds the current play to cart when numbers are complete. Cart shows '1 jugadas)' after adding

test_9_ctrl_enter_process_sale.description: 'Ctrl+Enter' processes the sale and creates ticket. Showed '¡Venta Exitosa!' modal with ticket TKT-20260213235543-1019

test_10_f_open_favorites.description: 'F' key opens the Favorites modal 'Mis Favoritos'

test_11_h_open_recent.description: 'H' key opens the Recent Plays modal 'Jugadas Recientes' with 14 recent plays

test_12_help_button_web_only.description: Help button (?) with data-testid='shortcuts-help-btn' is present in header on web platform

verified_features.help_button_web: VERIFIED - Present in header on web
